diagnosis: The current code applies journal events by received_at and offset <= max(cut), ignoring checkpoint lower bounds and per-partition cuts; it must filter checkpoint.offsets[p] < offset <= cut[p] before version choice. It keys records by (kind,id), merging merchants and captures/refunds with reused IDs; it must key by (merchant,kind,id). It filters statuses before version selection, so voided, pending, and canceled replacements cannot remove older amounts; it must select highest normalized version first, then apply status rules. It neither normalizes schema 1 by currency scale nor removes schema/transport from conflict comparison; JPY must use zero decimals and normalized bodies decide duplicates/conflicts. It cannot detect same-version conflicting bodies or block affected groups. It also treats refunds as independent amounts instead of validating capture merchant/order/currency/version, revisiting checkpoint refunds against final capture state, and deferring all otherwise eligible refunds when their sum exceeds the capture.
regression_checks: Partition filter: with checkpoint p=40,q=80 and preview p=55,q=95, include p-55 and q-95 but exclude p-39, p-56, and q-96; north/A remains blocked by deferred R7 and still has refund R1 because q-96 is beyond preview.
Identity scope: north capture R1 and north refund R1 must coexist, and south C1 must not replace north C1; preview north/B includes the capture R1 amount while north/A includes refund R1.
Version before status: close north C1 version 3 voided contributes zero and q-96 canceled refund R1 contributes zero; no fallback to older captured/settled versions.
Conflict handling: preview north/capture/C4 and south/capture/C7 are conflicts and block their named groups while contributing no amount; close west/refund/R2 is a conflict, not a deferred refund.
Currency normalization: schema 1 JPY amount '900' is 900, not 90000; close east/J1 is captured 900, refunded 900.

Refund eligibility and over-refund: preview north refunds R3/R4 on C3 total 4500 against a 4000 capture, so both defer; close C3 is 3000 and eligible R3/R4 total 3800, so both still defer while R5 is separately deferred for requiring capture version 3.
